---
title: "Bad cell and div options (knitr)"
filters:
  - panzoom
expect-errors:
  - 'property name gruop is invalid'
  - 'ℹ The error happened in location panzoom:gruop, in the cell starting `plot(1)`.'
  - 'ℹ Did you mean group?'
  - 'Field "max-zoom" has value lots, which must instead be a number greater than 0'
  - 'ℹ The error happened in location panzoom:max-zoom, in the cell starting `plot(1)`.'
  - 'Field "hint" has value "true", which must instead be `true` or `false`'
  - 'ℹ The error happened in location panzoom:hint, in the cell starting `plot(1)`.'
  - 'ℹ Quarto uses YAML 1.2, which interprets booleans strictly.'
  - 'ℹ Try using true instead.'
  - 'Field "fit" has value sideways, which must instead be one of: `auto`, `contain`, `height`, `width`'
  - 'ℹ The error happened in location panzoom:fit, in the cell starting `plot(1)`.'
  - 'Field "description" has value ["a","b"], which must instead be a string'
  - 'ℹ The error happened in location panzoom:description, in the cell starting `plot(1)`.'
  - 'Field "backdrop" has value red; } body {, which must instead be a CSS color'
  - 'ℹ The error happened in location panzoom:backdrop, in the cell starting `plot(1)`.'
  - 'Field "panzoom" has value maybe, which must instead be `true`, `false` or a map of options'
  - 'ℹ The error happened in location panzoom, in the cell starting `plot(2)`.'
  - 'Field "panzoom" has value no, which must instead be `true`, `false` or a map of options'
  - 'ℹ The error happened in location panzoom, in #gallery-div.'
  - 'Field "link-color" has value red; }, which must instead be a CSS color'
  - 'ℹ The error happened in location link-color, on the image ../../images/mv-1.jpg.'
---

Mistakes in `#| panzoom:` cell options, in a div's `panzoom=`, and in an
image's styling attributes.

```{r}
#| panzoom:
#|   gruop: a
#|   max-zoom: lots
#|   hint: "true"
#|   fit: sideways
#|   description: ["a", "b"]
#|   backdrop: "red; } body {"
plot(1)
```

```{r}
#| panzoom: maybe
plot(2)
```

::: {.panzoom #gallery-div panzoom="no"}
![An image in a div.](../../images/mv-0.jpg)
:::

![A marked image.](../../images/mv-1.jpg){.panzoom link-color="red; }"}
